SEARCH
Package com.signalwire.sdk.cli.simulation

Class ServerlessSimulator

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.cli.simulation.ServerlessSimulator
public final class ServerlessSimulator extends Object
Build a layered EnvProvider that overlays simulated serverless environment values on top of the real process environment.

Java cannot mutate System.getenv() at runtime (the map it returns is an immutable snapshot of the OS env). To implement the swaig-test --simulate-serverless flag in the same spirit as Python's mock_env.py, we therefore cannot "set env vars then clean up" — we instead compose an injectable EnvProvider and thread it through every code path in the SDK that reads env vars.

Accepts only the platforms the port actually implements. Ports that add CGI / GCF / Azure support later should extend presetFor(Platform).

Mirrors the clear-and-warn semantics of Python's _clear_conflicting_env: SWML_PROXY_URL_BASE is masked in the simulated view so that platform-specific URL generation is actually exercised. If the caller's real OS env has SWML_PROXY_URL_BASE set, the simulator does not mutate the real env — it simply returns null for that key through the layered EnvProvider. Callers that want to surface the mismatch to the user can check proxyUrlBaseMaskedFromRealEnv().

  • Constructor Details

    • ServerlessSimulator

      public ServerlessSimulator(ServerlessSimulator.Platform platform)
      Build a simulator for the given platform using the real process environment as the fallback layer.
      Parameters:
      platform - platform to simulate.

    • ServerlessSimulator

      public ServerlessSimulator(ServerlessSimulator.Platform platform, EnvProvider realEnv, Map<String,String> overrides)
      Build a simulator with explicit env + overrides. The overrides map supplies the simulated values (e.g. AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME). If it omits a key the preset supplies, the preset's default is used.
      Parameters:
      platform - platform to simulate.
      realEnv - fallback env provider (usually EnvProvider.SYSTEM).
      overrides - user-supplied overrides on top of the platform preset.

    • parsePlatform

      public static ServerlessSimulator.Platform parsePlatform(String s)
      Parse the CLI-string form of a platform. Accepts only values this port supports; unknown strings throw IllegalArgumentException so the CLI can surface a clear error instead of silently falling back.
      Parameters:
      s - user-supplied platform string.
      Returns:
      the matching ServerlessSimulator.Platform.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for unsupported platforms.

      public ServerlessSimulator.Platform getPlatform()

    • getSimulatedEnv

      public Map<String,String> getSimulatedEnv()
      Returns:
      the map of simulated values layered on top of the real env. The returned map is a defensive copy.

    • getMaskedKeys

      public Set<String> getMaskedKeys()
      Returns:
      an immutable view of the keys that are masked (returned as null) regardless of what the real env has for them.

    • proxyUrlBaseMaskedFromRealEnv

      public boolean proxyUrlBaseMaskedFromRealEnv()
      Returns:
      true if the real process env has SWML_PROXY_URL_BASE set — i.e. the simulated view is hiding a real value the user might not have intended. The CLI uses this to print a warning that mirrors Python's behaviour.

    • buildEnvProvider

      public EnvProvider buildEnvProvider()
      Build the layered EnvProvider. Precedence is:
      1. masked keys — always return null.
      2. simulated values — overlaid on the real env.
      3. Real env — everything else passes through.
      Returns:
      layered env provider.
